patch.title: 学术润色三个章节：统一 trajectory tracking / parameter restriction / beyond this range 术语，拆分 intro 与 appendix 的长句并修正语法，$\tau=0.5$ 与 \ref{fig:tracking} 保持不变。

hunks.oldText: Our trajectory method has a clear weakness: it degrades when observations are delayed. Figure~\ref{fig:tracking} reports the comparison.
hunks.newText: Our trajectory-tracking method has a clear weakness. Its performance degrades when observations are delayed. Figure~\ref{fig:tracking} presents the comparison.

hunks.oldText: We study trajectory tracking under the parameter restriction $\tau=0.5$. The controller does not claim robustness beyond this range.
hunks.newText: We study trajectory tracking subject to the parameter restriction $\tau=0.5$. The controller does not claim robustness beyond this range.

hunks.oldText: The proof use same trajectory track restriction $\tau=0.5$ and it not claim robustness outside this range.
hunks.newText: The proof uses the same parameter restriction $\tau=0.5$. It does not claim robustness beyond this range.
